sourceSets.title: Listening practice: three speakers

script.speaker: narrator
script.spoken: Listen to three students. You will hear each speaker’s number.

script.speaker: speaker_1
script.spoken: Speaker One. For our class photo, I’d like us to wear the same colour. We don’t need to buy anything. I already have a blue shirt, and I can wear that. Different shirts are fine if we all choose blue.

script.speaker: speaker_2
script.spoken: Speaker Two. I’d rather let everyone choose their own colour for the photo. I want to wear my green top. We can look like a group without wearing the same thing.

script.speaker: speaker_3
script.spoken: Speaker Three. For me, the important thing is to feel comfortable. We’ll be standing outside for a while. I’m going to wear my warm coat over my shirt.

sourceSets.scriptProvenance: Original fictional practice dialogue by Codex, following the Unit 1 clothing/preference and gist/detail/speaker targets; not copied from publisher audio.

recordingBrief.voiceRights: Obtain actual voice/asset permission; plan acceptance is not a rights attestation. No provider, API spend or voice cloning is enabled.
recordingBrief.review: Listen to the whole final file, verify every word and speaker number, complete a key-to-time/turn check and mobile/desktop playback verification.
